headline: Oilers’ Howard out week-to-week with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Oilers forward Howard is out week-to-week with a lower-body injury, hurt on a knee-on-knee hit from the Islanders' Emil Heineman. The report doesn't say how long Howard will be out beyond that.

For Heineman, the bigger question is whether the hit costs him anything. The Islanders winger has 2 goals and 4 assists in 14 games so far this season, and he sits slightly below his expected total (2 goals against 2.57 expected, which measures the quality of his chances). His team gets 54% of the expected goals at 5-on-5 when he's on the ice, and NYI's overall share is 4 points better with him out there, so he's helping more than the box score shows. A reporter's post from NHL.com's Stefen Rosner noted a Heineman major in the opening period of an Oct. 31 game, though it doesn't say whether it's tied to this play. For EDM, the stakes are real: they're 11-2-2 but have been outplayed at 5-on-5 (49% of expected goals), so a lineup hole matters.
